title: DIY Mobile Workbench for DeWalt DW745 Table Saw
excerpt: Build a mobile outfeed and assembly workbench designed to integrate the DeWalt DW745 table saw. Includes free plans and SketchUp files.
body:
## Overview I built this mobile outfeed/assembly/workbench to integrate my DeWalt DW745 (European model) table saw into my workshop. The goal was to create a practical, mobile and versatile workspace for cutting, assembling and general work. ## Dimensions - Length: 234 cm - Width: 100 cm - Height: 92 cm ## Materials - 12x Pine framing wood (100mm x 50mm) - 16mm Valchromat (top) - 12mm OSB (bottom shelf) - Screws - Wood glue - Casters ## Cost The total cost was approximately $200. ## Features - Integrated DeWalt DW745 table saw - Large assembly surface - Bottom storage shelf - Fully mobile design ## Image Gallery
## Free Plans & Files All plans and SketchUp files for this project are available below in the download section. If you found this project useful, feel free to support the channel. ## Contact If you build one, I would love to see your results. 👉 Contact me via the contact page
